shared_contract.scope_of_limits: These are native operation ceilings; extraction supplements have additional, sometimes lower bounds. Upstream parsing/decoding can allocate before local checks.
shared_contract.untrusted_execution: Use supervised CLI workers after immutable acquisition. Direct Rust calls do not acquire process isolation merely by constructing Context.
shared_contract.containment: Verified Linux seccomp_sealed denies path IO, sockets, exec and process creation across worker threads. Threads remain allowed without a separate PID/cgroup/thread-count cap. The controller/publisher retain their intended file access.
shared_contract.platform_limit: Linux x86_64 has bounded runtime evidence. Linux aarch64 is source-only here; Landlock reports ENOSYS, and other platform/toolkit parity is unverified.
shared_contract.provenance: Original bytes/source hashes and raw observations remain distinct from derived projections; app-generated artifact names, no-clobber staging and explicit mutation/repair provenance are required. Publication transport now binds a fresh invocation identity, controller-owned ordered staged-input digests/sizes, operation, public options and exact response capture; private-request/password digests stay private. This does not prove artifact semantics.

global_remaining_obligations: Parent must reconcile the separately preserved PR273 and native checkpoints, then attach exact combined-source build/test and ARM64 Native receipts before proposing an existing-PR273 update. Native source 3251660 receipts are preserved separately.

Backpressure, atomic publication, cleanup/cancellation, memory limits, filesystem/network/process denials and SSRF/RCE-related negative controls are bounded case evidence, not broad safety certification or a destructive fork-bomb test.

Exact parent-confirmed counterexample fixture identities and the broader frozen parity corpus remain outstanding; approved synthetic equivalents preserve defects without substituting for those fixtures.

No private keys, real signing, credential discovery, remote model/TSA fetching, persistent MCP registration, new queue/database service, publication/release or protected-branch merge is implemented by this status overlay.

capabilities.bounded_adapter_coverage: AES-256 revision-6 encryption and authenticated decryption create full-rewrite derivatives.
